title: Code from session is not validated
comment: `session.get('code')` trusts the client. Look the code up in `Discounts` and check expiry before use.

title: Rounding happens twice
comment: `apply_discount` rounds, then `total` rounds again. Round once, at the end.

title: Percent and fixed codes share one branch
comment: A fixed code of 10 is read as 10%. Split on `kind`.

title: No test for an expired code
comment: Add a case for an expired code; it should not change the total.
